title: Death means Player Head ( AwakenSMP++ )
description: A plugin that, if a player dies at the hands of another player, their head drops and they enter spectator mode. When you place their head, they will respawn - provided they are online.
body:
# **NEED TO KNOW!**
The basic command is __/dmph__, there is also a command 
```
/dmph language <your language>
```
This command allow you to change the plugin language to your native one! Current possible languages to use: **_EN, PL, ES, FR, IT, DE, RU_**


### **Informations about plugin**
When you kill a player, their **head** falls out, and they gain spectator mode upon death. Place their head on the ground to revive them! However, if the head is lost, for example, in the void, the only way to resurrecting him is to craft the **Book of Salvation**, it allows you to resurrect the player by dematerializing itself!


**IMPORTANT!**
If you want to respawn a player with a book or with his head, it requires his activity in the form of being **online on the server!**

## **CRAFTINGS AND RESOURCE PACK**

The Book of Salvation:



![Book of Salvation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef2a278de281996a78795e023aaedb97c2f37d28.png)


# SOON!
### **Optional resource pack for plugin** _( resource-pack-sha1, resourca-pack, 1.20 - 1.21.11 )_

**server.properties**
```
resource-pack: 
resource-pack-sha1: 
```
